pages.text: Some moons give you an ability. They all use one key: $(l)Moon Ability$(), $(k:ecmoons.moon_ability) by default. Change it under $(o)Options > Controls > Enhanced Celestials Moons$().$(br2)On any other night the key just says "No moon ability tonight".
pages.title: Moon Ability Key

pages.text: The server decides everything: timing, distance, cooldowns and where an ability is allowed. A small indicator next to the crosshair shows steps, windows, charge and cooldowns.$(br2)Abilities never work in the War Moon arena or for players taking part in a War Moon tournament. They end if you die, log out or change dimension.
